answer: Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each identity pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the marble rate. The vine curve is published each epoch, tide records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 62 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
